findings: Combined unfunded pension + OPEB is $684.5M as carried at 2025-06-30, not the $773.1M FY2021 inflation-adjusted figure the ledger uses.
Structural accrual is +$344,207/yr - effectively flat, and 0.5% of the capital side's $71.8M/yr.
Pension amortization exceeds interest by only $3.65M/yr on a $641M balance: 0.57% principal reduction, ~176 years at that pace.
OPEB employer contributions cover 71.6% of employer normal cost, so the OPEB unfunded balance grows structurally.
